subject: Burst tagging mismatch and VAT liability for March spike
messages:
From: Emma Rodriguez <emma@brightfwd.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Lee <sam.lee@brightfwd.com>, procurement-eu@brightfwd.com
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected March 31 burst charge — need token export + VAT question

Hi Priyom,

We saw a ~2.4M token charge on March 31 that doesn't match our reported traffic. It looks like a single burst attributed to our production prefix, but we believe that traffic came from a staging job. Can you: 1) provide a token-level export for 2027-03-31 to 2027-04-01 (UTC) with prefix tags, and 2) confirm whether VAT was applied to the March invoice?

We are an EU entity (BrightFWD GmbH) and provided a VAT number during onboarding — procurement would prefer reverse-charge if the invoice is issued to our EU entity. Attaching a copy of the invoice we received and a small sample CSV from our side (brightfwd-token-sample-20270401.csv) showing the session IDs we think are staging.

Emma
Emma Rodriguez
Head of Platform Engineering
BrightFWD Inc.
attachments: brightfwd-token-sample-20270401.csv, invoice-202703.pdf
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Apr 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected March 31 burst charge — need token export + VAT question

Hi Emma — thanks for the heads up and the sample. I’ve opened BRIGHT-7129 in our tracking system and looped in Billing (Ben) and Finance (Marissa). Quick notes:

- We’ll pull a token-attribution export for the UTC window you listed and confirm prefix tags and session IDs.
- If traffic was mis-tagged by our SDK/client-side prefix tagging, we’ll propose a corrective credit.
- For VAT: please confirm the exact legal entity name and the VAT number you want us to use on the invoice; Ben will outline next steps.

Ben/Marissa/Karthik — I’m assigning this to billing workflow for an initial attribution run. Ben, can you run a sampling export and confirm whether the tokens were attributed to the production prefix or if there's evidence of a staging prefix collision? Karthik — if we need a quick log-level check, can we prioritize the prefix-resolution path?

I’ll follow up with the export by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415 555 0219
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>, Emma Rodriguez <emma@brightfwd.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 10:13:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected March 31 burst charge — need token export + VAT question

Emma / team — I pulled a preliminary attribution run for 2027-03-31 00:00:00 UTC -> 2027-04-01 00:00:00 UTC. Summary:

- There is a spike at 2027-03-31T21:04:12Z for ~2.3M tokens. Our logs show that the majority of requests in that 10-min window were labeled with the production prefix '/prod/main'.
- However, we also see a client-side SDK tag collision for session ids that match the sample you sent. The SDK v2.1 had a bug where ephemeral jobs could inherit the last-used prefix if prefix reset was not explicit.
- Attached is a small sampling snippet (sampling-snippet.log) showing the session -> prefix mapping. You can see the staging job using session IDs starting with stg- that were labeled /prod/main at ingestion.

Proposed next steps:
1) We will issue a provisional credit for the mis-attributed portion: $7,800 (estimated) while we complete a full export and confirm exact token counts.
2) Engineering recommends upgrading the client to v2.2 (fix for prefix reset) — we can provide a small patch and migration notes.
3) VAT: Our system currently invoiced the charge to the entity on file (BrightFWD Inc, US billing). If you confirm you want the invoice issued to BrightFWD GmbH and provide your VAT number/certificate, Finance will reissue a corrected invoice and apply reverse-charge if applicable.

I’ve attached the sampling snippet and the provisional credit calc. If you want us to pause collection while we sort, Marissa can advise on collections hold.

Ben Carter
Billing Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: sampling-snippet.log
From: Emma Rodriguez <emma@brightfwd.com>

Date: Sat, 03 Apr 2027 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected March 31 burst charge — need token export + VAT question

Thanks, Ben — that sampling snippet lines up with our internal traces. Confirming: please reissue the invoice to "BrightFWD GmbH" (legal: BrightFWD GmbH, VAT DE123456789). I’ve attached our VAT certificate (brightfwd-vat-certificate.pdf).

We accept the proposed provisional credit while you run the full export. For collections, please place the disputed amount on hold while this is reconciled — procurement will not release payment for the disputed line until a corrected invoice is received.

Priyom/Ben/Marissa — please confirm timeline: when can we expect the full token export and the corrected invoice? Also, can engineering provide the v2.2 client patch and a short migration note for our infra team?

—Emma
